6 kap. dataskyddslagen and Art 58 GDPR; fines collected after the decision gains legal force.

checked.claim: Public authorities can be fined, caps SEK 5m and SEK 10m (6 kap. 2 §)
checked.evidence: 6 kap. 2 §: 'Hogst 5 000 000 kronor' for Art 83.4, 'Hogst 10 000 000 kronor' for Art 83.5-83.6.

checked.claim: Payment within 30 days of legal force (6 kap. 2 §)
checked.evidence: The 30-day payment rule is in 6 kap. 6 §, not 2 §: '30 dagar fran det att beslutet om att ta ut avgiften har fatt laga kraft'.
checked.replacement: The fine must be paid within 30 days of the decision gaining legal force (laga kraft), or a longer period set in the decision (6 kap. 6 §), so an appeal in practice defers payment. Fines are only available for Art. 83 GDPR breaches, plus Art. 10 GDPR (criminal data) breaches (6 kap. 1 and 3 §§). No criminal offences in the Act.

checked.claim: Five years, opportunity to comment (6 kap. 2 §)
checked.evidence: The limitation is in 6 kap. 4 §: 'Fem ar fran den dag da overtradelsen agde rum'.
checked.replacement: A fine may not be decided unless the party has been given the opportunity to comment within five years of the day the infringement took place (6 kap. 4 § dataskyddslagen).

checked.claim: Payment due 30 days after legal force (6 kap. 2 §)
checked.evidence: Wrong section: payment rule is 6 kap. 6 §.
checked.replacement: Payment is due only 30 days after the decision gains legal force (6 kap. 6 §), so the fine is not collected while an appeal is pending; corrective orders' suspensive effect not confirmed.

checked.claim: Three weeks from receipt, FL s. 44, not confirmed
checked.evidence: Forvaltningslagen 44 §: 'Ett overklagande av ett beslut ska ha kommit in till beslutsmyndigheten inom tre veckor fran den dag da den som overklagar fick del av beslutet'. The appeal is lodged with IMY, which forwards it.
checked.replacement: Three weeks from the day the appellant received the decision, lodged with IMY, which forwards it to the court (förvaltningslagen 2017:900, s. 44).

checked.claim: Appeal to general administrative courts (7 kap. 3 §), in practice Forvaltningsratten i Stockholm
checked.evidence: 7 kap. 3 § provides appeal to administrative court with leave for higher instances; the Google and Spotify cases were heard by Forvaltningsratten i Stockholm.

checked.evidence: 6 kap. 8 § (SFS 2025:256, in force 1 May 2025) confirmed for three months and two weeks; 7 kap. 3 a § allows appeal of a refusal. The 'deemed refused' wording was not seen in the extract.
